## Classification
- Type: Public contact request only, not a vulnerability report
- Status: Awaiting a secure reporting channel

## Why
I need a private route to contact maintainers about a potential security
issue. No technical details are provided in this public Issue.

## Outcome
A maintainer identifies a verified private reporting channel.

## Scope
- Included: Request private contact instructions only.
- Excluded: Vulnerability details, exploit steps, logs, private files, hostnames,
  credentials, personal data, or reproduction evidence.

## Project metadata
- Primary label: security

## Acceptance
- [ ] The reporter can send details over a verified confidential channel.

## Dependencies and boundary
This Issue is public when the repository is public. Do not paste technical
details here, even in later comments. Follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md).

## Evidence
No security evidence belongs in this public Issue. Provide it only after
a private channel has been established.
